194:t_1:3.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

194:t_1:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Well, $$宗介$$. Be careful out there.」

194:t_1:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Be sure to rescue $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$-chan. I helped make their costumes, you know.」

194:t_1:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And after that, $$ラース・バビロン$$... Be sure to win.」

194:t_1:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Listen... this is a farewell scene, so you could say a bit more than that, right...?」

194:t_1:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「A bit more... such as what?」

194:t_1:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Like, 'I'll win no matter what,' or 'I'll make a miracle happen'...」

194:t_1:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Victory is merely the result of strategy and tactics. A soldier can only give everything he has within that.」

194:t_1:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah, yeah... Even right before a major operation, you're the same as ever. What a relief.」

194:t_1:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...But... be sure to come back...」

194:t_1:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll try. With everything I have.」

194:t_1:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain... Why are you in the hangar...」

194:t_1:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To say farewell to everyone. From here on, the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will act separately.」

194:t_1:23.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll make sure $$カナメ$$ is delivered safely to Japan, too.」

194:t_1:25.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So $$カナメ$$ matters more to you than saying goodbye to me.」

194:t_1:27.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm joking. I was just being a little mean, as your friend.」

194:t_1:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then, allow me to say something too. As your friend.」

194:t_1:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$テッサ$$... You take care too.」

194:t_1:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
(No matter what happens from here on, he and I will surely remain 'friends'...)

194:t_1:33.en:
$$テッサ$$
(In the end, I couldn't beat her... that girl, and the dazzling world she belongs to...)

194:t_1:34.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Maybe I, too, was only yearning for that world... through him...)

194:t_1:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Yes... of course... Whenever something became clear to him, $$相良$$ always went straight toward it...)

194:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's just... I was a little... a little disappointed, I guess...」

194:t_1:50.en:
$$テッサ$$
(No excuses, no words of encouragement... No, he's desperately holding those words back...)

194:t_1:53.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Now I have no regrets. Sergeant $$相良$$, let us both give our all to the missions ahead of us.」

194:t_1:55.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And one more thing... a single caution. Once you've rescued $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$, please look after $$ランカ$$.」

194:t_1:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you mean by that, ma'am...?」

194:t_1:57.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...No... that was presumptuous of me. Please forget it.」

194:t_1:59.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Well then, $$相良$$... I wish you the best of luck.」

194:t_1:61.en:
$$テッサ$$
(Goodbye, $$相良$$... and goodbye, my feelings...)

194:t_1:63.en:
$n
「So this is where you were, $$宗介$$. The meeting for the infiltration operation is about to start.」

194:t_1:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... it's nothing. I'll be right there.」

194:t_1:67.en:
$n
「What do you mean, it's nothing... You...」

194:t_1:68.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$n... Let's be sure to get back to $$陣代高校$$.」

194:t_1:70.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... We've only just said goodbye, and yet right now I want to see you so badly...)

194:t_1:74.en: ～ $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$, Detention Facility ～

194:t_1:76.en:
$$シェリル$$
「What a dump. Locking up the $$銀河の妖精$$ and the Super Dimension Cinderella in a gloomy place like this.」

194:t_1:78.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Hey... why don't we sing a little to lift our spirits? Rock in a prison has a certain charm.」

194:t_1:79.en:
$$シェリル$$
「And if it helps the people imprisoned here even a little...」

194:t_1:80.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry... I just... can't feel like doing that...」

194:t_1:82.en:
$$シェリル$$
「But it's all right. $$アルト$$ and the others... $c will surely come for us.」

194:t_1:83.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You believe in $$アルト$$, don't you, $$シェリル$$...」

194:t_1:84.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Maybe that's a bit optimistic? But even up to now...」

194:t_1:85.en:
$$ランカ$$
「That's not what I'm trying to say...!」

kept_omissions: 194:t_1:12: Kaname quotes Sousuke in the first person ('I'll win', 'I'll make a miracle happen'); kept as quoted speech
194:t_1:84: Sheryl's 'But even up to now...' trails off; kept unfinished as in the Japanese
uncertain: 194:t_1:76: 超時空シンデレラ rendered 'Super Dimension Cinderella' (plain words, no glossary token; 銀河の妖精 uses the keyword token)
194:t_1:54/56: 了解であります and とおっしゃられますと to Tessa rendered with 'ma'am' (Jigoku used 'sir' for the same Japanese)

194:t_1:33: あの子 taken as Kaname (female, the scene settles it) - 'that girl'
194:t_1:20 etc: サガラさん -> plain $$相良$$ per earlier slices; 軍曹 -> 'Sergeant $$相良$$' in 194:t_1:53
